name: National Cyber League (NCL)
description: National cybersecurity competition for students and individuals, endorsed by the National Science Foundation (NSF). Bridges academic learning and professional practice.

peerReview.processDescription: Individual and team-based competitions. Academic integration into cybersecurity curricula. Challenges cover reconnaissance, web exploitation, cryptography, forensics, RE. Endorsed by NSF.

attribution.attributionNotes: NCL scores recognized by employers and academic institutions. NSF endorsement. Verifiable skill metrics for job seekers.

povsAlignment.description: Tool development / benchmarking through NSF-endorsed academic competition.
